saints.name: St. Willibrord
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The Northumbrian monk who became the Apostle of the Frisians and first Archbishop of Utrecht…
biography: Born in Northumbria about 658 and formed in the monastery of Ripon and among the Irish in Ireland, Willibrord crossed to the Continent in 690 with a band of companions to preach the Gospel to the pagan Frisians. Consecrated bishop of the Frisians by Pope Sergius I in Rome in 695, he fixed his see at Utrecht.

For more than forty years he evangelized the Low Countries, founding churches and the great monastery of Echternach, which became the centre of his mission and his burial place. He died on 7 November 739. He is honoured as the Apostle of the Frisians and a patron of the Netherlands and Luxembourg.
saints.knownFor: The evangelization of Frisia and the see of Utrecht.
